testcase.name: Scenario: Minimize the ribbon while an expanded panel is pinned: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-panel-expansion-source/features/application/ribbon-panel-expansion/ribbon-panel-expansion.feature:232:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Minimize the ribbon while an expanded panel is pinned ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open and active ✔ And the full Tools ribbon uses the Cycle Through All display policy ✔ And the Options additional command area is open and pinned ✔ And clicking outside the panel leaves the additional area open ✔ When the user activates the ribbon display control ✔ Then the ribbon shows compact panel buttons ✔ And the Options additional command area is no longer visible ✔ When the user continues the display cycle to restore the full ribbon ✔ Then the full Tools ribbon is visible ✔ And the Options additional command area is not automatically reopened ✔ When the user opens the Options additional command area and clicks outside it ✔ Then the additional area closes
